project_type: MCP server (superset of Playwright MCP) with a local ONNX 'Laya' decision engine for browser automation. TypeScript, ESM, Node >=20.
language: TypeScript (ESM, strict). Emits dist/ via tsc.
build_system: npm scripts over tsc + vitest. pnpm-lock.yaml is the committed lockfile (an untracked package-lock.json exists in the tree - DO NOT commit it, leave it untracked). node_modules is already installed. Chromium Playwright binary is already installed.
test_framework: vitest (test/*.test.ts). Real headless chromium tests use a local fixture HTTP server helper at test/helpers/fixture-server.ts serving test/fixtures/*.html. Pure-logic tests (config, types, safety pure guards, snapshot-diff, redaction) run without a browser. Tests that need a browser construct `new BrowserSession({ headless: true })`.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) then `npm run test` (vitest run). Baseline before this task: 154 passed / 3 skipped, typecheck clean. The 3 skips are the WebKit launch smoke test (gated) and the two real-weights Autopilot tests (LAYA_MODEL_DIR unset). Keep those skips; do not turn them into failures. Run `npm run bench` for the C1 comparison numbers (offline goal benchmark over local fixtures with the stub engine).
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is build output (gitignored). benchmark/ artifacts (results.json, RESULTS.md, charts) are produced by `npm run bench:compare` (needs its own dev deps + network). `npm run bench` runs test/benchmark/report.test.ts and only prints a summary; it does not check in artifacts. No snapshot testing framework in use.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed (node_modules present, pnpm 10.28, node 22). Chromium already installed via `npx playwright install chromium`. No further setup needed. Network is OPEN_INTERNET but this is a HEADLESS Linux sandbox with NO display server: every browser test MUST run headless (headless:true). The browser defaults to headed with a graceful headless auto-fallback in BrowserSession.launch() - do NOT regress that fallback.
environment_constraints: HEADLESS-ONLY sandbox (no display server). All new browser tests must pass headless. Do NOT introduce Playwright `networkidle` waits or `slowMo`. Do NOT write to stdout anywhere (stderr only - stdio JSON-RPC integrity). No secrets in logs (feature B1). Firefox/WebKit are gated; use chromium for all new tests.
contribution_requirements: Everything additive and backward-compatible. Existing tests, tool contracts, RunResult/StepRecord shapes must remain intact (except ADDITIVE new outcome values / optional fields). All new config knobs go through src/config.ts (parsed ONCE, typed, LAYA_-prefixed env, with an override field on ConfigOverrides). No scattered process.env reads. Update README config-reference table + Safety-guards / Autopilot / Tools sections. Never use em dashes in prose. Commit logically onto the existing branch feat/overlay-tiers-autopilot-narration; do NOT push, do NOT create/modify a PR.
key_patterns: Boundary discipline: config parsed once in src/config.ts (helpers envBoolDefaultTrue/envBoolDefaultFalse/parseNumber/clamp/parseList/parseViewport/parseHexColor). src/browser.ts (BrowserSession) is the SOLE Playwright boundary and owns one BrowserOverlay. src/snapshot.ts capture() runs an in-page domWalk via page.evaluate and stamps data-laya-ref='eN'. src/state-builder.ts buildState() clamps controls to ~20 (RECOMMENDED_MAX_OPTIONS). src/autopilot/loop.ts runGoal() is the loop; execute() is the ONLY IO switch; a Narrator facade narrates each step through the overlay and is inert with no overlay/page. src/safety.ts has PURE guards (checkDomainAllowed, checkDestructiveSubmit). Tools in src/tools/*.ts, capability-gated via REGISTRY in src/tools/index.ts; shared.ts has ToolContext + snapshotResult. src/overlay.ts BrowserOverlay = server controller + injected client IIFE (window.__layaOverlay), extended by adding methods to the client `api` object AND a guarded server method that delegates via call(). Types (PageState/Control/Decision discriminated union/RunOutcome) in src/types.ts + loop.ts. MCP SDK 1.30.1: tool handlers receive (args, extra); extra._meta.progressToken + extra.sendNotification enable notifications/progress; server.server.elicitInput(...) enables elicitation; server.server.createMessage(...) is sampling (already used by escalation).
